Function: BenchmarkStatistics.public static double Percentile(IReadOnlyList<double> values, double percentile)
Rationale: Percentile: empty list returns 0, NaN or out-of-range percentile throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException via the negated range check; at percentile 1.0 upper index is n-1 (no overrun); linear interpolation checked for n=1 and n=2. NaN or double.PositiveInfinity inputs would yield NaN (inf minus inf) but benchmark durations never hold them. Tests: BenchmarkStatisticsTests (empty, out-of-range, single, two values, p50/p95).
OrderBy key selector x=>x: identity ascending sort over a copy (ToArray), caller list is not mutated; double.CompareTo orders NaN first, irrelevant for finite timings.

PreRead.get: reads the Lazy snapshot, parsed once so two reads in one process cannot disagree; only the exact value 1 enables it (documented). Tests: DiagOptionsTests BooleanFlags_OnlyOneEnables, Snapshot_IsStableUntilReset.
PreloadWorkers.get: int? from snapshot; unparsable or out-of-range is null (not 0), so 0 workers stays distinguishable. Tests: PreloadWorkers_Range, PreloadWorkersZero_IsEnabled.
DisableDiskCache.get: snapshot read, strict 1 comparison; no I/O. Covered by SingleFlag_DoesNotLeakIntoOthers.
ForceLog.get: snapshot read; consumed once at startup. Covered by BooleanFlags_OnlyOneEnables.

InstanceLabel.get: null when unset or blank (whitespace-only checked); label text is not length-limited or stripped of control characters but is only shown in the window title of a manually launched instance. Test: InstanceLabel_NullWhenBlank.

AnyEnabled.get: ORs all five flags including InstanceLabel is not null, so a label alone counts as enabled; consistent with Describe. Covered by Defaults_AreAllDisabled and SingleFlag_DoesNotLeakIntoOthers.

Describe: PRELOAD_WORKERS formatted with InvariantCulture (CA1305), fixed flag order, (none) when empty; InstanceLabel is appended raw so an env value containing a newline would split the forced startup log line (own environment, negligible). Test: Describe_ListsActiveFlagsInOrder.
ResetForTests: swaps the volatile Lazy field, so the next read re-parses; a reader holding the old Lazy keeps a consistent old snapshot. Only used by tests in the GlobalState collection.

ReadFromEnvironment: int.TryParse uses NumberStyles.Integer plus InvariantCulture (RV-S02), range 0..16 enforced, null/garbage workers become null, blank label becomes null; ToString order unaffected. Tests: PreloadWorkers_Range, InstanceLabel_NullWhenBlank.

Lazy factory lambda: builds the default FileLog from AppPaths.FromEnvironment() on first use; LazyThreadSafetyMode.ExecutionAndPublication so one instance; an exception in AppPaths would be cached by Lazy and rethrown on every Default access (AppPaths only resolves LocalAppData, not expected to throw).
Default.get: returns the Lazy value; FileLog constructor performs no I/O (INV-10 zero I/O when disabled), verified by test DisabledLoggingCreatesNoDirectoryOrFile.

Function: FileLog.public FileLog(IAppPaths appPaths, long maxLogBytes = 10 * 1024 * 1024) : this(appPaths?.LogFile ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(appPaths)), maxLogBytes)
Rationale: IAppPaths constructor: null appPaths throws ArgumentNullException before delegating (appPaths?.LogFile ?? throw); an empty LogFile string is rejected by the string overload via ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace.

String constructor: Path.GetFullPath makes the path stable if the process CWD changes later; maxLogBytes floored at 1024 so a zero or negative value cannot rotate on every drain; no I/O. Test: LogFileRotatesAtThreshold, LogAtExactLimit_IsRotated.

PendingCount.get: Volatile.Read of the counter used by tests (QueueCap_Boundary). Counter is incremented before the cap trim, so it can read MaxQueuedEntries+1 for an instant; harmless for a diagnostic.
DroppedCount.get: Interlocked.Read for a 64-bit value (atomic on 32-bit too). Test: QueueIsBoundedWhenLogFileCannotBeWritten.
FilePath.get: returns the full path computed in the constructor; immutable.
Enabled.get: volatile bool read; reflects Write acceptance only approximately (can flip right after) which is acceptable for the INV-10 gate.

Enabled.set: true goes through Start (no-op when disposed), false clears the flag, signals and does a bounded Flush (2 s) which also returns early on an unwritable log (_lastDrainFailed). Writer thread stays alive after disable (idle 250 ms wake-ups, no I/O). Tests: DisablingLoggingStopsWrites, EnableAfterDispose_DoesNotStartWriter, ShutdownDoesNotStallOnUnwritableLogFile.
Info: forwards to Write with INFO; null message interpolates to empty text, no throw. See Write for the line-injection note.
Warn: forwards to Write with WARN; same contract as Info.

Function: FileLog.public void Error(string message, Exception? ex = null)
Rationale: Error: forwards exception to Write; Exception.ToString is evaluated later on the writer thread (see W2CM-01 for the consequence if ToString throws).
Flush(): public wrapper with the 2000 ms budget; returns early when drained or when the last drain failed. Tests: Flush_ReleasedWhenDrainFinishes, Flush_DrainedSetWhileEntryQueued_WaitsUntilWritten.

Flush(int): re-checks the real condition (queue empty, _writing, _lastDrainFailed, HandlesReleased) instead of trusting _drained, sleeps 1 ms when _drained is already set to avoid a spin, and returns on ObjectDisposedException from either handle; remaining budget decreases by at least 1 ms per loop so it terminates. Tests: Flush_SignalDisposed_ReturnsImmediately, Flush_DrainedEventDisposed_ReturnsImmediately, Flush_DrainedSetWhileEntryQueued_WaitsUntilWritten.

Shutdown: sets _stopping/_enabled, signals, then Join plus Flush share one 2 s budget (was 4 s on the UI thread); a writer blocked in I/O costs at most 2 s and is abandoned. A Start() racing Shutdown while the old thread is still alive could leave the log enabled with no writer (needs Enabled=true during app exit, not a real path). Tests: Shutdown_StuckWriter_UsesOneSharedBudget, Dispose_DrainsEveryQueuedEntryToDisk.
IsWriterAlive.get: null-safe IsAlive read on a thread reference that Start assigns under the lock; test-only seam.
WaitWriterExit: null writer returns true (nothing to wait for), otherwise Join(timeout); test seam.

Dispose: idempotent via _disposed, shuts down first, and skips handle release when the writer outlived its 2 s join so the background thread never hits ObjectDisposedException; WriterLoop releases them on exit. _disposed is a plain bool (two simultaneous Dispose calls could both pass) but Shutdown and ReleaseHandles are idempotent so the race is benign. Tests: UseAfterDispose_NeverThrows, Dispose_StuckWriter_DefersHandleRelease, DisposeWithBlockedWriterDoesNotDisposeHandlesUnderTheWriter.
HandlesReleased.get: Volatile.Read of the int flag; used by Start, Flush and tests.
ReleaseHandles: Interlocked.Exchange makes it single-shot between Dispose and the writer-exit path; disposes both wait handles. Test: Dispose_ClosesWaitHandles.

Start: under _sync lock; returns for a disposed or released log (a new writer would die on disposed handles and crash the process); reuses a live writer, creates a background named thread otherwise; clears _stopping so re-enable after Shutdown works while the thread is still alive. Tests: EnableAfterDispose_DoesNotStartWriter, EnabledButIdle_CreatesNothingOnDisk.

Function: FileLog.private void Write(string level, string message, Exception? exception)
Rationale: Write: bounded queue with drop-oldest (MaxQueuedEntries), ObjectDisposedException swallowed, timestamp captured on the caller thread. The message is stored and later written verbatim, so a message containing a line break plus a forged timestamp/level prefix produces a fake log line; i18n warnings built from untrusted translation file text (key names, JSON error text) are logged through this path (LocalizationService line 70). OddMessages_WrittenVerbatim pins verbatim output, so this is a decision to revisit. See W2CM-02.
Signal: Set on the AutoResetEvent, ObjectDisposedException swallowed after Dispose; used by Enabled.set and Shutdown.

WriterLoop: 250 ms wait so a lost signal self-heals, Drain per tick, final Drain after _stopping, and deferred ReleaseHandles when Dispose was blocked. Drain swallows every non-OOM exception so the loop cannot die and take the process down. Test: DisposeWithBlockedWriterDoesNotDisposeHandlesUnderTheWriter.

Drain: entries are dequeued only after Flush, so when a write fails midway (IOException on disk full, or Exception.ToString throwing for one entry) the lines already pushed to disk by StreamWriter.Dispose stay queued and are appended again on the next 250 ms drain; a throwing entry stays at the head and blocks everything behind it until 10000 newer writes trim it. Rotation, culture-invariant format and the ReferenceEquals dequeue guard otherwise checked OK. Tests cover total failure (UnwritableLog_EntriesAreKeptForTheNextDrain) but not partial failure. See W2CM-01.

NeedsRotation: File.Exists then FileInfo.Length >= max (at-limit rotates, test LogAtExactLimit_IsRotated). A delete between the two calls throws FileNotFoundException outside the rotation try, which the outer catch turns into a retried drain; negligible.

Rotate: File.Move to name.1.ext with overwrite so only one backup generation is kept (older history is overwritten by design); IO or access failures are caught by the caller and logging continues appending. Tests: ReadOnlyBackup_LoggingContinues, LockedBackup_LoggingContinues, Rotation_NoEntryLost.
NullLog.Enabled: constant false so callers skip message construction; matches ILog contract.
NullLog.Info: empty body, never throws for null. Test: NullLogMethodsDoNotThrow.
NullLog.Warn: empty body. Test: NullLogMethodsDoNotThrow.

Function: NullLog.public void Error(string message, Exception? ex = null)
Rationale: NullLog.Error: empty body, accepts a null exception. Test: NullLogMethodsDoNotThrow.

OnEventSourceCreated: touches only the const ProviderName so it is safe when the base EventListener constructor calls it before field initializers; enables Informational level for exactly the PhotoReview-Perf source. Test: Enqueue_Normal_IsWrittenNotDropped (end to end).

OnEventWritten: now delegates to Enqueue with a build closure (see N-core-misc-001/003); never throws into the EventSource dispatcher. Closure allocation per event is acceptable because tracing is opt-in.

BuildRow(EventWrittenEventArgs): forwards EventName (falling back to the invariant-formatted EventId) with PayloadNames and Payload to the testable overload; null name list handled downstream. Test: BuildRow_NullLists_YieldEmptyRow.

IsNumeric: long, int, double and bool count as numeric columns; other integral types (short, byte, uint, enum) would fall into the text column, but PhotoReviewPerf only declares long, int, double, bool.

FormatValue: bool as 1/0, double as G17 round-trip with InvariantCulture, other IFormattable with InvariantCulture, null as empty; G17 prints noisy digits (0.1 becomes 0.10000000000000001) which is lossless for the analyzer. Test: BuildRow_FormatsValuesInvariantly, Rows_AreCultureInvariant.

TryStartFromEnvironment: unset or whitespace variable returns null with nothing on disk; directory and file creation failures return null; if Start throws the listener is disposed and the partial file deleted. FileShare.Read lets the analyzer tail the file. If the StreamWriter constructor itself threw the FileStream would leak until finalization (cannot happen for a writable FileStream). Test: TryStartFromEnvironment_BadPaths_ReturnNull.
DroppedCount.get: Interlocked.Read of the 64-bit counter; test seam used by DroppedRowsAreCountedAndReported.

Function: PerfCsvListener.internal static PerfCsvListener StartForTest(Stream stream, int capacity)
Rationale: StartForTest: internal seam constructing the listener with a caller stream and capacity; no production caller.

Function: PerfCsvListener.private void Start(Stream stream, int capacity = ChannelCapacity)
Rationale: Start: bounded channel with DropWrite plus the itemDropped callback (the CORE-03 fix: a full DropWrite channel returns true from TryWrite), SingleReader true, header written before the writer task starts. Test: DroppedRowsAreCountedAndReported.
itemDropped lambda: Interlocked.Increment of _dropped; runs on the producer thread, allocation free.

WriteHeader: entry-assembly informational version (or unknown), only non-empty DIAG variables, FormattableString.Invariant for the frequency; raw env values are written unescaped on a comment line (a value with a newline could add a fake row, own environment only). Test: Header_ContainsVersionAndDiagFlags.
Select lambda name/value pair: reads each diagnostic environment variable once; pure projection.
Where lambda p.value filter: drops unset or empty variables so the header lists only active flags.
Select lambda name=value: culture-free string interpolation of strings only.

WriterLoopAsync: flushes only when a later row arrives more than 1 s after the last flush, so rows written in the last second of a burst sit in the StreamWriter buffer until Dispose; a killed or crashed process loses the tail of the trace. Any exception (disk full) ends the loop silently, after which rows pile up in the channel and are not reflected in the dropped trailer. See W2CM-04.

WriteRow: integers written with Write(long/int) on a StreamWriter whose FormatProvider is the current culture, but long and int digits have no culture-specific grouping or digits except negative sign; all text columns pass CsvEscape; line terminator is a fixed LF. Test: Rows_AreCultureInvariant.
FlushWriter: best-effort Flush with exceptions swallowed so the finally in WriterLoopAsync cannot throw.

CsvEscape: line breaks flattened to a space before quoting (R2-F-32) so one event is exactly one line; quotes doubled and fields with commas quoted; empty string fast path. Tests: CsvEscape_FlattensLineBreaks, CsvEscape_QuotesCommasAndDoublesQuotes_WithoutLineBreaks, CsvEscape_RoundTrips.

Dispose: completes the channel then Wait(5 s) on the writer task; if that times out (writer stuck in I/O) the code still writes the dropped trailer and disposes the StreamWriter concurrently with the writer thread, and StreamWriter is not thread safe (garbled tail or swallowed exceptions). Normal path (writer drains and exits) verified correct, double Dispose guarded by Interlocked. Tests: DisposeUnderLoad_ProducesWellFormedFile, Dispose_Twice_AndEventsAfterwardsIgnored. See W2CM-04.
Private constructor: empty; forces the singleton Log. The EventSource base constructor registers the source (EventSource name PhotoReview-Perf fixed by attribute).
NavContext.get: AsyncLocal long, default 0 outside any navigation; preload uses -1 by convention.
NavContext.set: AsyncLocal write flows to child async contexts only, so a set inside a callee does not leak to the caller; documented usage.

PathId: SHA-256 of the upper-cased full path truncated to 4 bytes (32 bits): with about 50000 photos in a folder the birthday collision probability is roughly 25 percent, so two photos can share a pathId and PerfAnalysis would merge their events. Path.GetFullPath throws on a path with invalid characters (callers feed enumerated file names so not reachable). Culture independent via ToUpperInvariant. Tests: PathId_StableAcrossCulturesAndCase, PathId_RelativeEqualsFull. See W2CM-06.
Ms: delta of Stopwatch ticks times 1000 divided by Frequency in double; non-negative for monotonic snapshots. Tests: Ms_NonNegative, Ms_ConvertsTicksToMilliseconds.

MsSinceProcessStart: wall clock difference to the cached process start; uses a Lazy so a concurrent first call cannot read a half-written DateTime. A system clock step during the run skews the number (diagnostic only). Test: MsSinceProcessStart_Plausible_UnderContention.

ReadProcessStartUtc: Process.GetCurrentProcess disposed via using, StartTime converted to UTC; for the own process this does not fail in practice, and a failure would be cached by Lazy and rethrown from App startup marks only when a trace listener is attached.
StartupMark: checks Log.IsEnabled() before computing the timestamp so no Process query happens without a listener (zero overhead rule). Test: StartupMark_EmitsStartupEvent.
TrackedSourceOpenPaths.get: ConcurrentDictionary.Count (takes all striped locks, test and diagnostic use only). Test: SourceOpenTable_TrimsToThreeQuartersOfCap.
RecordPreloadHit: Interlocked.Increment, thread safe. Test: RecordMethodsAccumulateCorrectly.
RecordInflightJoin: Interlocked.Increment. Test: RecordMethodsAccumulateCorrectly.
RecordDiskCacheHit: Interlocked.Increment. Test: RecordMethodsAccumulateCorrectly.
RecordUiAssign: negative milliseconds clamped to 0 so a clock step cannot shrink the total (Metrics_NegativeInputs_Clamped).
RecordCacheHit: Interlocked.Increment. Test: RecordMethodsAccumulateCorrectly.
RecordCacheMiss: Interlocked.Increment. Test: RecordMethodsAccumulateCorrectly.

RecordDecoderFallback: ConcurrentDictionary.AddOrUpdate keyed by the DecoderBackend enum; the update delegate may be retried under contention but the stored sum is still correct. Test: StatSessionWriteAndFallbackCountsAccumulate.
AddOrUpdate update lambda (_, count) => count + 1: pure, safe to re-run when the CAS loses.

Function: ReviewMetrics.public void RecordSourceRead(long bytes, long milliseconds, bool includeInDecodeEwma = true)
Rationale: RecordSourceRead: bytes and ms clamped at 0 before the Interlocked.Add calls; the EWMA is skipped when includeInDecodeEwma is false (full-size decodes do not distort preload pacing). Tests: FullDecodeSourceReadIsCountedInTotalsButDoesNotAffectPreloadEwma, Metrics_NegativeInputs_Clamped.
DecodeMillisecondsEwma.get: Interlocked.Read of the long that holds the double bits, so the 64-bit read is atomic on any platform. Test: DecodeMillisecondsEwma_StartsAtFirstSampleThenSmooths.

UpdateDecodeEwma: CAS loop on the bit pattern, first sample seeds the average, alpha 0.2; a sub-millisecond decode recorded as 0 ms is skipped (biases the average slightly upward, acceptable for pacing). Terminates because each iteration either succeeds or observes another thread's progress.
RecordPresented: clamps negative, increments count and sum, and bucket index is within 0..7 (PresentBucketIndex returns at most UpperBounds.Count). Test: PresentLatencyIsBucketed.

RecordSourceOpen: total plus per-path (OrdinalIgnoreCase) counts, trimming when above 4096 paths; a null path would throw ArgumentNullException but both callers pass enumerated file paths; Count takes all dictionary locks per call (negligible next to a file open). Tests: SourceOpensAreCountedInTotalAndPerPath, SourceOpenTableIsBounded_TopPathsAndTotalSurvive.
AddOrUpdate update lambda: count + 1, pure.

TrimSourceOpens: lock plus recheck so concurrent callers trim once; removes the least-opened entries down to 3072, using TryRemove(pair) so an entry re-opened meanwhile survives; the total counter is untouched. Test: SourceOpenTable_TrimsToThreeQuartersOfCap.
OrderBy key selector p.Value over a ToArray snapshot (not the live dictionary); ties arbitrary as documented.
RecordStat: Interlocked.Increment. Test: StatSessionWriteAndFallbackCountsAccumulate.
RecordSessionWrite: Interlocked.Increment. Test: StatSessionWriteAndFallbackCountsAccumulate.
RecordCrossThreadPresent: Interlocked.Increment. Test: CrossThreadPresentCountAccumulates.

PresentBucketIndex: linear scan over the 7 inclusive upper bounds, falls through to the unbounded last bucket; label array has 8 entries so indices line up (the coupling is by hand, guarded by PresentLatencyIsBucketed).

Snapshot: each counter read atomically but not as one consistent cut (acceptable for diagnostics); dictionary copies via ToArray so a growing table cannot throw (the CopyTo race noted in the source); DecoderFallbacks copy enumerates the ConcurrentDictionary safely. Test: ConcurrentRecordingIsThreadSafe, NewFieldsAreSerialized.
OrderByDescending key p.Value over the snapshot array: deterministic ordering with the ThenBy key.
ThenBy key p.Key with OrdinalIgnoreCase comparer: stable tie-break so TopSourceOpens is reproducible.
Select projection to SourceOpenEntry: pure copy of key and count.
Histogram Select (label, i): reads _presentBuckets[i] with Interlocked.Read, i bounded by the label array which equals the bucket array length.
DecoderFallbackCount.get: Values.Sum() (long) over the immutable snapshot copy; cannot overflow in practice.

EnglishLocalizer.get: Lazy value shared by Localizer.Current default; immutable so safe across threads.

Tests: BuiltInEnglish_EmbeddedCatalog_IsValidAndComplete, ShippedEnglishFile_MatchesEmbeddedCatalog.

Tests only cover the missing-name case. See W2CM-03 and W2CM-02.

Tests: TryParse_PluralNotNone_DefaultsToOneOther, UnknownPlural_Warns.

IsValidCode: length checked before indexing code[0]; first char ASCII letter, rest ASCII letters, digits or hyphen, so a code cannot carry path separators; trailing or doubled hyphens are accepted (harmless, code is never used as a path). A null argument would NRE (only called with non-null). Test: IsValidCode_VariousCodes_MatchesRule.
All lambda c => IsAsciiLetterOrDigit(c) or hyphen: ASCII-only so Unicode digits are rejected.

Function: LanguageLoader.public LanguageLoader(IFileSystem fileSystem, string shippedDir, string? userDir)
Rationale: Constructor: null fileSystem or shippedDir throws ArgumentNullException, userDir may be null (user folder optional). Test: Constructor_NullArguments_Throw.
DiscoverLanguages: one pass over both folders, warnings discarded for this listing (Load keeps them). Tests: DiscoverLanguages_* family.

Rationale: Discover: English built in always first, first catalog per code wins (shipped before user), codes compared OrdinalIgnoreCase; sorted by native name with CurrentCultureIgnoreCase (UI ordering, allowed by AGENTS rule 3). Test: DiscoverLanguages_ShippedAndUser_EnglishFirstEachCodeOnceSortedByNativeName.

ThenBy key NativeName with culture-aware ignore-case comparer: display ordering only.

Function: LanguageLoader.public Localizer Load(string? code, CultureInfo? uiCulture = null)
Rationale: Load: single folder read, resolved code picks overlays (shipped first, user last via stable OrderBy(IsUser)), English only takes user overrides (shipped en.json ignored in favour of the built-in), warnings flow into the localizer. Tests: Load_ShippedAndUser_UserWinsPerKey, Load_UserEnglishOverride_AppliesOnlyWhenEnglishSelected, Load_ShippedEnglishFile_NotUsedAsOverlay.
Where lambda code equals resolved (OrdinalIgnoreCase): selects every catalog of the language across both folders.
OrderBy x.IsUser: false before true, stable so shipped precedes user and files within a folder keep name order.
Select x.Catalog: projection only.
Where lambda user and English code: selects only user English overrides.
Select x.Catalog: projection only.

Function: LanguageLoader.public string Resolve(string? code, CultureInfo? uiCulture = null)
Rationale: Resolve (public): runs discovery then the shared resolver; each call re-reads and parses every language file (called from settings UI, not hot path).

Function: LanguageLoader.private static string Resolve(IReadOnlyList<LanguageInfo> languages, string? code, CultureInfo? uiCulture)
Rationale: Resolve (static): explicit non-auto code resolved case-insensitively else English; auto tries full culture name (vi-VN) then two-letter code, invariant culture (empty name) falls to English; a regional catalog like pt-br is not chosen for pt-PT (documented behaviour in Resolve_AutoWithRegionalCatalog_PrefersFullCultureName).
Select l => l.Code: projection.
FirstOrDefault lambda c equals code OrdinalIgnoreCase: returns the catalog's own casing so downstream matches are consistent.
FirstOrDefault lambda c equals culture.Name: exact regional match first.
FirstOrDefault lambda c equals TwoLetterISOLanguageName: language-only fallback.

Function: LanguageLoader.private IEnumerable<(LanguageCatalog Catalog, bool IsUser)> ReadAll(List<string> warnings)
Rationale: ReadAll: lazy iterator, shipped folder first then user folder if configured; used twice only via ToList or spread so folders are enumerated once per call.

Function: LanguageLoader.private IEnumerable<LanguageCatalog> ReadFolder(string dir, List<string> warnings)
Rationale: ReadFolder: missing dir yields nothing, listing errors warn, dotted names (en.notes.json) skipped, size gate by stat then by decoded UTF-8 byte count (covers missing or stale stat), IO and access errors per file warn and continue. ReadAllText failures other than IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException (for example NotSupportedException) are not caught, but the production IFileSystem raises IOException family. Tests: Load_FileLargerThanMax_SkippedWithWarning, Load_FileExactlyMax_IsRead, OversizedFile_WithoutStat_Skipped, OversizedMultibyteFile_WithoutStat_Skipped, Load_UnreadableFile_ReportedInWarnings.
OrderBy f => f OrdinalIgnoreCase: deterministic file order so later files win per key reproducibly.

Function: Localizer.private Localizer(string code, string nativeName, PluralRule plural, FrozenDictionary<string, LocTemplate> templates, IReadOnlyList<string> warnings)
Rationale: Constructor: precomputes baseKey to (.one, .other) pairs once from keys ending in .other; a base with only .one is not in the table and is handled by the slow path in FormatPlural. Test: FormatPlural_PicksFormByCountAndRule.
Current.get: Volatile.Read with lazy default via CompareExchange so two racing readers agree on one instance. Tests: Current_NotReplaced_IsBuiltInEnglish, SwapWhileRendering_NeverTornOrNull.

SetCurrent: the swap is atomic but the multicast CurrentChanged is invoked directly, so an exception from one handler (MainWindow.OnLanguageChanged calls RefreshLocalizedText) skips the remaining handlers (the WPF indexer notification may be among them) and propagates to the language-switch caller after the new localizer is already current. No handler is known to throw, so not proven. See W2CM-07.
SetDefault: CompareExchange only when null, returns whatever won, so a SetCurrent racing the first read is not overwritten.
Keys.get: FrozenDictionary key collection of the English-derived key set; read only by tests and tooling.
Contains: ContainsKey on the frozen dictionary, case sensitive (Ordinal), null key would throw ArgumentNullException.

Get: unknown key returns the key itself (documented fallback) and known keys render with no arguments so placeholders stay visible as {name}. Tests: Get_MissingKey_ReturnsKey, Get_TemplateWithPlaceholders_LeavesPlaceholdersVisible.

Function: Localizer.public string Format(string key, params ReadOnlySpan<LocArg> args)
Rationale: Format: unknown key returns key; arguments by name, unknown or mismatched names do not throw. Test: UnknownAndMismatchedArguments_DoNotThrow.

Function: Localizer.public string FormatPlural(string baseKey, long count, params ReadOnlySpan<LocArg> args)
Rationale: FormatPlural: fast path uses the precomputed pair (.one only when rule is OneOther and count is exactly 1), slow path falls back .one to .other and finally to the .other key text; negative or zero counts take .other (correct for English). Null baseKey throws. Tests: FormatPlural_OneOther_PicksOneOnlyForCountOne, FormatPlural_PluralNone_AlwaysUsesOther, FormatPlural_OneFormAbsent_FallsBackToOther, FormatPlural_NoFormsAtAll_ReturnsOtherKey.

Function: Localizer.public Localizer Transform(string code, string nativeName, PluralRule plural, Func<string, LocTemplate, LocTemplate> transform)
Rationale: Transform: rebuilds a localizer with every template rewritten, keys unchanged so the plural table is recomputed consistently; a delegate returning null would produce a null template and an NRE at render (caller contract). Test: FormatPlural_UsesTransformedTemplates.
ToFrozenDictionary key selector p => p.Key: identity.
ToFrozenDictionary value selector p => transform(p.Key, p.Value): calls the translator-mode delegate once per key.

Function: Localizer.public static Localizer Create(LanguageCatalog english, IReadOnlyList<LanguageCatalog> overlays, IEnumerable<string>? priorWarnings = null)
Rationale: Create: invalid English template degrades to a literal with a warning; overlays validated per key (unknown key ignored, bad braces rejected, unknown placeholder rejected, missing placeholder only warns), later overlay wins, partial same-language overlay keeps shipped nativeName and plural unless declared, rejected entries keep the earlier value. A language that translates only .other but not .one keeps English text for count 1 (partial translation, not a defect). Tests: Create_* family in LocalizerTests, LocalizerPartialOverlayTests.
ToDictionary key selector p => p.Key: copy of English templates used as the validation reference.
ToDictionary value selector p => p.Value: identity.
FirstOrDefault lambda n => !allowed.Contains(n): finds a placeholder not present in English, case sensitive; small arrays so linear Contains is fine.
FirstOrDefault lambda for a placeholder English has but the translation omits: warn only, entry still accepted (documented).

Function: LocTemplate.private LocTemplate(string text, string[] literals, string[] names)
Rationale: Private constructor: stores text and the literal/name arrays; invariant literals.Length == names.Length + 1 is guaranteed by the three creators (TryParse, Literal, TransformLiterals).
PlaceholderNames.get: returns the internal string[] as IReadOnlyList; callers could cast and mutate but only in-repo callers read it.

Function: LocTemplate.public static bool TryParse(string text, [NotNullWhen(true)] out LocTemplate? template)
Rationale: TryParse: brace escapes {{ and }} handled; unmatched } or { without closing } rejected; name must start with an ASCII letter followed by letters or digits; null throws; no length limit but input is bounded by the 1 MB file cap. Checked edge cases: {a{b} rejected, {x}} rejected, {{{a} accepted as literal brace then placeholder. Tests: TryParse_InvalidTemplate_ReturnsFalse, TryParse_ValidTemplate_ReturnsTrue, Render_DoubledBraces_RendersLiteralBraces.
Literal: single literal and no placeholders so braces render verbatim; used for English entries that failed to parse and for show-keys mode. Test: Literal_TextWithBraces_RendersVerbatim.

TransformLiterals: applies the delegate to every literal segment in order and re-escapes braces in the rebuilt Text so it re-parses to the same segments; the delegate is evaluated eagerly (ToArray) so the pseudo-mode first-segment flag is deterministic. Test: CreatePseudo_Placeholders_StillFormatted.
AppendLiteral: clones the literal array before appending so the original template stays unchanged; escapes braces in Text. Test: CreatePseudo_PaddingLength.

Render: no-placeholder fast path, thread-static StringBuilder taken out of the slot while in use so nested renders are safe and returned only if capacity is at most 1024; a missing argument writes {name} back. Claim that rendering never throws holds except when an argument's own ToString throws (builder just not restored). Tests: Render_MissingArgument_WritesPlaceholderBack, Render_RepeatedPlaceholder_SubstitutesEveryOccurrence, SwapWhileRendering_NeverTornOrNull.

FormatValue: null empty, string as is, IFormattable with CurrentCulture (UI text, allowed by AGENTS rule 4), otherwise ToString or empty. Rendered text must not be written to machine-read files; the log-bound i18n warnings do not use it. Tests: Render_FormattableValue_UsesCurrentCulture, Render_NullValue_RendersEmpty.
IsValidName: empty rejected, first char ASCII letter, rest ASCII letters or digits (rejects {0} and {a-b}); span based, no allocation.
Select lambda (char)c over the code point list: pure cast, all values are BMP so no truncation.

CreatePseudo: delegates to Transform with the pseudo code qps-ploc and forced one-other plural; null source throws. Test: CreatePseudo_PlainText_IsAccentedBracketedAndLonger, CreatePseudo_PluralKeys_KeepPlural.
Transform lambda: per-template state (first flag) lives inside the lambda so each template gets its own opening bracket; padding based on original text length. Test: CreatePseudo_PaddingLength.
Literal-mapping lambda: accents each literal, prefixes [ only on the first segment, keeps placeholders untouched. Test: CreatePseudo_Placeholders_StillFormatted.
CreateShowKeys: keeps code, native name and plural of the source and replaces every text by [key]; null source throws. Test: CreateShowKeys_EveryText_IsItsKey.
Value lambda (key, _) => Literal([key]): drops placeholders on purpose so the key is shown verbatim.

Accent: ordinal IndexOf over the 52 ASCII letters, 1:1 mapping, non-letters unchanged; the 52-entry Accented table length matches Plain. Tests: Accent_AsciiLetters_MappedOneToOne, Accent_MapsFirstLetter.

Padding: zero length gives empty, otherwise a space plus ceil(35 percent) tildes with a minimum of one; Math.Ceiling on double, int cast safe for any realistic text length. Test: CreatePseudo_PaddingLength.

Function: UserFacingError.public static TException Localized<TException>(TException exception, Func<string> text) where TException : Exception
Rationale: Localized: null checks, stores the Func under a fixed Data key and returns the same exception instance with its type unchanged so type-based catch filters still work; Exception.Data accepts non-serializable values on .NET 10. Test: Describe_FollowsLanguageAtDisplayTime.
IsLocalized: tests the Data slot for a Func<string>; null throws; used by RawDecoder to avoid double wrapping.

Describe: evaluates the factory at display time so it follows the current language, falls back to Exception.Message when absent or when the factory throws (not for OutOfMemory); it does not look at InnerException, so a wrapper exception loses the inner localized sentence (callers catch the thrown exception directly today). Test: Describe_ThrowingFactory_FallsBackToMessage.

Function: AppVersion.public static bool TryParse(string? text, out AppVersion version)
Rationale: TryParse: strips leading v, +metadata, then pre-release suffix; requires exactly three all-ASCII-digit components, rejects empty parts, a trailing dash, four components and int overflow (NumberStyles.None, InvariantCulture); leading zeros accepted. Prerelease only flagged, identifiers not compared. Tests: AppVersionTests TryParse_Garbage_ReturnsFalse, TryParse_Prerelease_IsFlagged, AppVersionOperatorTests TryParse_RejectsNonDigits, TryParse_RejectsEmptyComponents.

CompareTo: numeric major, minor, patch then the pre-release flag (release greater than pre-release of the same numbers via other.IsPrerelease.CompareTo(IsPrerelease)); no overflow since components are ints compared not subtracted. Test: CompareTo_OrdersVersionsNumerically.

Function: AppVersion.public static bool operator <(AppVersion left, AppVersion right)
Rationale: operator less-than via CompareTo less than 0. Test: Operators_MatchOrdering.

Function: AppVersion.public static bool operator >(AppVersion left, AppVersion right)
Rationale: operator greater-than via CompareTo greater than 0. Test: Operators_MatchOrdering.

Function: AppVersion.public static bool operator <=(AppVersion left, AppVersion right)
Rationale: operator less-or-equal via CompareTo. Test: Operators_MatchOrdering.

Function: AppVersion.public static bool operator >=(AppVersion left, AppVersion right)
Rationale: operator greater-or-equal via CompareTo. Test: Operators_MatchOrdering.
ToString: major.minor.patch with InvariantCulture, intentionally drops the pre-release flag (UpdateChecker relies on the numeric form for display).

Function: UpdateChecker.public UpdateChecker(HttpMessageHandler? handler = null, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
Rationale: Constructor: stores the optional test handler and a timeout defaulting to 10 s; no validation of the timeout (a negative value other than -1 would make CancelAfter throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException inside CheckAsync; only tests pass custom values). Test: CustomTimeout_IsHonoured.

Function: UpdateChecker.public async Task<UpdateCheckResult> CheckAsync(string? currentVersion, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
Rationale: CheckAsync: linked timeout versus user cancel is classified correctly, body capped before parsing, any other exception becomes BadResponse; but every HttpRequestException (TLS or certificate failure, premature end of the body, proxy errors) is reported as Offline, and any HTTP 403 is reported as RateLimited even for non-rate-limit 403s (the existing gap test only asserts Failed). The user then sees a misleading message. Tests: NetworkException_ReturnsOffline, TimeoutStyleCancellation_ReturnsTimeout, CallerCancel_Throws, HttpError_MapsToFailure. See W2CM-05.

Function: UpdateChecker.private static async Task<string?> ReadCappedAsync(HttpContent content, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
Rationale: ReadCappedAsync: reads 16 KB chunks and rejects as soon as the running length would exceed 1 MB, so a missing or lying Content-Length cannot buffer an unbounded body (exact-limit accepted, one over rejected); stream disposed via await using; UTF-8 decode of the exact byte span. Tests: ExactlyMaxBytes_WithoutContentLength_IsAccepted, OneByteOverMax_WithoutContentLength_IsRejected, OversizedBody_ReturnsBadResponse.

Function: UpdateChecker.private static UpdateCheckResult Interpret(string body, AppVersion current)
Rationale: Interpret: non-object root, missing or unparsable tag_name and JSON errors give BadResponse; draft, pre-release flag or pre-release tag never offered; newer stable returns the validated html_url or the fixed releases page; GetString exceptions are caught by the caller catch-all. Tests: Newer_ReturnsUpdateAvailable, SameOrOlder_ReturnsUpToDate, DraftOrPrerelease_IsIgnored, ForeignUrl_FallsBackToReleasesPage, NonStringHtmlUrl_FallsBackToReleasesPage, BadJson_ReturnsBadResponse.

Function: UpdateChecker.private static string? ReadString(JsonElement obj, string name)
Rationale: ReadString: returns null for a missing property or a non-string kind (no exception on numbers or null); TryGetProperty is case sensitive as GitHub emits. Test: NonStringHtmlUrl_FallsBackToReleasesPage.
UpToDate factory: sets status and latest version only, DownloadUrl stays null. Covered by SameOrOlder_ReturnsUpToDate.

Function: UpdateCheckResult.public static UpdateCheckResult UpdateAvailable(string latestVersion, string downloadUrl)
Rationale: UpdateAvailable factory: stores version and the already validated URL; SettingsWindow re-validates before opening. Covered by Newer_ReturnsUpdateAvailable.
Failed factory: status Failed plus the failure code, no user data. Covered by HttpError_MapsToFailure.

Validate: requires absolute https, host github.com (OrdinalIgnoreCase, so github.com. or lookalike hosts fail), default port, no user info, and path equal to or under /ConanKLOP2/PhotoReview with a slash boundary (so PhotoReviewEvil fails); System.Uri collapses dot segments before AbsolutePath so /../ escapes fail; returns the normalized AbsoluteUri. Query and fragment are allowed, harmless. Tests: Validate_ProjectUrl_ReturnsUrl, Validate_Other_ReturnsNull.

PerfCsvListener.Enqueue(Func<Row>) (new since baseline, PR 285): null channel (construction not finished) drops silently, build or TryWrite failure counted as dropped, never throws into the EventListener dispatcher; after Dispose TryWrite returns false and is counted. Tests: Enqueue_BuilderThrows_IsCountedAsDropped, Enqueue_AfterDispose_IsCountedAsDropped, Enqueue_Normal_IsWrittenNotDropped.

Function: PerfCsvListener.internal static Row BuildRow(string eventName, IReadOnlyList<string>? names, IReadOnlyList<object?>? values) (new overload)
Rationale: PerfCsvListener.BuildRow(string, IReadOnlyList, IReadOnlyList) (new overload): nav or gen fills nav once, pathId once, numerics capped at four columns (extras ignored but counted), non-numeric non-null values joined with semicolons, mismatched list lengths use the shorter, null lists give an empty row; timestamps taken at build time. Tests: BuildRow_MapsNamedAndPositionalPayload, BuildRow_MoreThanFourNumerics_AreCappedAtFour, BuildRow_MismatchedLengthsUseTheShorterList, BuildRow_NullLists_YieldEmptyRow.

Lambda () => BuildRow(eventData) in OnEventWritten (new): captures the EventWrittenEventArgs and runs inside Enqueue's try/catch so a payload that breaks formatting is counted as dropped, not thrown. Test: Enqueue_BuilderThrows_IsCountedAsDropped.
